analysis.evidence: וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ introduces a famine in the land. The later phrase כָבֵד הָרָעָב refers back to that famine and gives its severity as the reason Abram went down to Egypt.
analysis.morphology: The prefixed conjunction וַ introduces a Qal wayyiqtol, third-person masculine singular, agreeing with רָעָב ‘famine’.

analysis.evidence: וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ introduces a famine in the land. The later phrase כִּי כָבֵד הָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ refers back to that famine and gives its severity as the reason Abram went to Egypt.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, masculine singular absolute, with no prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: A shortage of food affecting a region.
